verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              ततस्तेषु प्रयातेषु कौन्तेयः सत्यसङ्गरः। अभ्यभाषत धर्मात्मा भ्रातॄन्सर्वान्युधिष्ठिरः॥१॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said : They having gone, the virtuous-souled son of Kunti, Yudhishthira, of firm vows addressed all his brothers.

verses.sanskrit: द्वादशेमाः समास्माभिर्वस्तव्यं निर्जने वने। समीक्षध्वं महारण्ये देशं बहुमृगद्विजम्॥२॥
verses.english: "We shall have to live in this lonely forest for twelve years; do you find out in this huge forest a spot, spot, charming, auspicious and abounding in many deer, birds, flowers and fruits and filled with pious men, where we may live happily for all these years."

verses.sanskrit: बहुपुष्पफलं रम्यं शिवं पुण्यजनावृतम्। यत्रेमाः शरदः सर्वाः सुखं प्रतिवसेमहि॥३॥
एवमुक्ते प्रत्युवाच धर्मराजं धनञ्जयः। गुरुवन्मानवगुरुं मानयित्वा मनस्विनम्॥४॥
verses.english: Being thus addressed, Dhananjaya replied to the pious and intelligent (Yudhishthira) having honoured him as if he were his spiritual guide.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच।
              भवानेव महर्षीणां वृद्धानां पर्युपासिता। अज्ञातं मानुषे लोके भवतो नास्ति किञ्चन॥५॥
verses.english: Arjuna said: You have respectfully worshipped the old and great Rishis; there is nothing on this earth which is unknown to you.

verses.sanskrit: त्वया ह्युपासिता नित्यं ब्राह्मणा भरतर्षभ। द्वैपायनप्रभृतयो नारदश्च महातपाः॥६॥
verses.english: O best of the Bharatas, you have always worshipped the Brahmanas of great austerities such as Dvaipayana and Narada.

verses.sanskrit: यः सर्वलोकद्वाराणि नित्यं सञ्चरते वशी। देवलोकाद्ब्रह्मलोकं गन्धर्वाप्सरसामपि॥७॥
verses.english: Who, having controlled over senses, always wander over all the regions from the region of the celestials to those of Brahma, Gandharvas and Apsaras.

verses.sanskrit: अनुभावांश्च जानासि ब्राह्मणानां न संशयः। प्रभावांश्चैव वेत्थ त्वं सर्वेषामेव पार्थिव॥८॥
verses.english: You know well, without any doubt, the opinions of all the Brahmanas; you know, O king, the prowess of all.

verses.sanskrit: त्वमेव राजञ्जानासि श्रेयःकारणमेव च। यत्रेच्छसि महाराज निवासं तत्र कुर्महे॥९॥
verses.english: You know also, O king, what conduces to our well-being; and wherever you wish, O great king, we shall fix our habitation.
verses.bhavadeepa: अनुभावान् कर्तव्याकर्तव्यविषयान् निश्चयान्। प्रभावो निग्रहानुग्रहशक्तिः ‘अनुभावो निश्चये स्यात्प्रभावः शक्तितेजसोः’ इति विश्वः ॥८॥

verses.sanskrit: इदं द्वैतवनं नाम सरः पुण्यजलोचितम्। बहुपुष्पफलं रम्यं नानाद्विजनिषेवितम्॥१०॥
verses.english: Here is the lake called Dvyaitavana, resorted to by the pious, abounding in many flowers and fruits, charming and inhabited by birds of diverse species.

verses.sanskrit: यत्रेमा द्वादशसमा विहरेमेति रोचये। यदि तेऽनुमतं राजन्किमन्यन्मन्यते भवान्॥११॥
verses.english: If you please, O king, we would like to live here for twelve years; do you think otherwise?
verses.bhavadeepa: द्वैतं द्वौ शोकमोहौ इतौ गतौ यस्मात्तद्द्वीतं द्वीतमेव द्वैतम् । स्वार्थे तद्धितः । वनं जलं यस्मिन् द्वैतवनं पुण्येन पावनेन जलेन उचितं समवेतम् एतेन द्वैतवनशब्दार्थः सूचितः । उचसमवायेदिवादिः॥१०॥

verses.sanskrit:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच।
              ममाप्येतन्मतं पार्थ त्वया यत्समुदाहृतम्। गच्छामः पुण्यविख्यातं महद्द्वैतवनं सरः॥१२॥
verses.english: Yudhishthira said : I do fully approve of what you have said. O Partha, let us repair to that sacred and celebrated lake Dvyaitavana.

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              ततस्ते प्रययुः सर्वे पाण्डवा धर्मचारिणः। ब्राह्मणैर्बहुभिः सार्धं पुण्यं द्वैतवनं सरः॥१३॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said : Thereupon the pious sons of Pandu, followed by numberless Brahmanas all repaired to the holy lake Dvyaitavana.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणाः साग्निहोत्राश्च तथैव च निरग्नयः। स्वाध्यायिनो भिक्षवश्च तथैव वनवासिनः॥१४॥
verses.english: The Brahmanas, some offering sacrifice to the fire, some without it, some engaged in the study of the Vedas, some depending upon alms and some living in the forest, all these numberless Brahmanas as well as hundreds of Mahatamas of accomplished ascetic piety and hard austerities surrounded Yudhishthira.

verses.sanskrit: बहवो ब्राह्मणास्तत्र परिवव्रुर्युधिष्ठिरम्। तपःसिद्धा महात्मानः शतशः संशितव्रताः॥१५॥
ते यात्वा पाण्डवास्तत्र ब्राह्मणैर्बहुभिः सह। पुण्यं द्वैतवनं रम्यं विविशुर्भरतर्षभाः॥१६॥
verses.english: And setting out with these numberless Brahmanas the Bharata chiefs, the sons of Pandu, entered the holy and the charming forest of Dvyaita.

verses.sanskrit: तमालतालाम्रमधूकनीपकदम्बसर्जार्जुनकर्णिकारैः। तपात्यये पुष्पधरैरुपेतं महावलं राष्ट्रपतिर्ददर्श॥१७॥
verses.english: The king saw that huge forest covered, at the end of summer, with Shalas palms, mangoes, Madhukas, Nipas, Kadambas, Sarjas, Arjunas, Karnikaras clothed with flowers;

verses.sanskrit: महाद्रुमाणां शिखरेषु तस्थुर्मनोरमां वाचमुदीरयन्तः। मयूरदात्यूहचकोरसङ्घास्तस्मिन्वने बर्हिणकोकिलाश्च॥१८॥
verses.english: And peacocks, Datyuhas, Chakoras, Barhins and Kokilas sat on the top of the highest trees and emitted their sweet notes. saw
verses.bhavadeepa: तपात्यये वर्षासु । महाबलं महावनम् । दन्त्यादिरयं शब्दः । देवा वै वले गाः पर्यपश्यन् इति वने वलशब्दप्रयोगदर्शनात् ॥१७॥

verses.sanskrit: करेणुयूथैः सह यूथपानां मदोत्कटानामचलप्रभाणाम्। महान्ति यूथानि महाद्विपानां तस्मिन्वने राष्ट्रपतिर्ददर्श॥१९॥
verses.english: In that forest the king (also) saw the leaders of elephant-herds, gigantic like hills with temporal juice trickling down in the season of rut and accompanied by herds of she-elephants.

verses.sanskrit: मनोरमां भोगवतीमुपेत्य पूतात्मनां चीरजटाधराणाम्। तस्मिन्वने धर्मभृतां निवासे ददर्श सिद्धर्षिगणाननेकान्॥२०॥
verses.english: And approaching the picturesque Bhagavati (Sarasvati) he many ascetics of accomplished piety in that forest in the hermitages of pious (Rishis) of purified souls and wearing bark and matted-locks.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स यानादवरुह्य राजा सभ्रातृकः सजनः काननं तत्। विवेश धर्मात्मवतां वरिष्ठस्त्रिविष्टपं शक्र इवामितौजाः॥२१॥
verses.english: Thereupon descending from his chariot, the king, the foremost of the pious, with his brothers and followers, entered the forest like Indra of mincasurable prowess entering heaven.

verses.sanskrit: तं सत्यसन्धं सहिताभिपेतुर्दिदृक्षवश्चारणसिद्धसङ्घाः। वनौकसश्चापि नरेन्द्रसिंहं मनस्विनं तं परिवार्य तस्थुः॥२२॥
verses.english: With a view of seeing the truthful king many Charanas and Siddhas approached him; and the dwellers of the forest stood encircling that highly intelligent chief of kings.

verses.sanskrit: स तत्र सिद्धानभिवाद्य सर्वान्प्रत्यर्चितो राजवद्देववच्च। विवेश सर्वैः सहितो द्विजाग्र्यैः कृताञ्जलिर्धर्मभृतां वरिष्ठः॥२३॥
verses.english: Then saluting all the Siddhas and being adored by them in return like a king or a god, that foremost of the pious, accompanied by all the leading twice-born, entered (the forest).

verses.sanskrit: स पुण्यशीलः पितृवन्महात्मा तपस्विभिर्धर्मपरैरुपेत्य। प्रत्यर्चितः पुष्पधरस्य मूले महाद्रुमस्योपविवेश राजा॥२४॥
verses.english: And being worshipped in return by those pious ascetics who had approached him that pious and high-souled king, sat down with them at the foot of a huge tree covered with flowers like her father Pandu in the days of yore.

verses.sanskrit: भीमश्च कृष्णा च धनञ्जयश्च यमौ च ते चानुचरा नरेन्द्रम्। विमुच्य वाहानवरशाश्च सर्वे तत्रोपतस्थुर्भरतप्रबर्हाः॥२५॥
verses.english: Bhima, Krishna (Draupadi), Dhananjaya, the twins and all their retinue all wearied and leaving conveyances sat on all sides of that foremost of kings.

verses.sanskrit: लतावतानावनतः स पाण्डवैर्महाद्रुमः पञ्चभिरेव धन्विभिः। बभौ निवासोपगतैर्महात्मभिर्महागिरिर्वारणयूथपैरिव॥२६॥
verses.english: The huge tree, bent down with the weight of creepers, with those five illustrious bowmen sitting under it for rest, appeared like a mountain with five gigantic elephants resting at its side.
